name: jpchauny-plugins
description: Indra Software Factory: an app of Claude Code plugins for working in three layers - specifications (people), norms (generated), code (agents). Each module is a plugin, installed on its own in the repository of its layer

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Module utilities: tools usable in any layer - explore before specifying or building; pending items and findings as a tree of GitHub issues; explanations one step at a time; a recap of the current session

plugins.name: project-management
plugins.description: Module project-management: the three repositories of a project, their creation and their life cycle (/project-management:create-project)

plugins.name: specs-management
plugins.description: Module specs-management, layer 1: the AI recommends how to improve the specs that the authors write (/specs-management:audit)

plugins.name: norms-management
plugins.description: Module norms-management, layer 2: the norms and every specification derived from them; the norms generator (/norms-management:build, /norms-management:verify)

plugins.name: code-implementation
plugins.description: Module code-implementation, layer 3: code built from the norms, and its traceability to norm IDs

plugins.name: drift-management
plugins.description: Module drift-management: a drift between specs and code, sent back to layer 1

plugins.name: workflow-orchestration
plugins.description: Module workflow-orchestration: the flow across the modules - what starts a run, the order of the steps, the hand-offs, and how each step runs in its repository
